summary: Implemented a typed Mongoose connection lifecycle with validated and redacted MongoDB configuration, reconnect/error/disconnect state tracking, liveness and dependency-readiness routes, environment-specific non-destructive index policy, and a synthetic local/UAT seed harness that is idempotent and refuses Production before connecting. Added unit coverage and synchronized OpenAPI, Postman, environment examples, and database documentation without implementing later domain tasks.
